metaTitle: Level 3 Reiki Healing Course in Bali Indonesia
metaDescription: Reiki is a spiritual practice that originated in Japan in the early 20th century. The word "Reiki" is a combination of two Japanese words: "rei," meaning universal, and "ki," meaning life
summary: Students are guided through the intricacies of Reiki symbols, attunements, and advanced techniques, with hands-on experience in providing Reiki sessions to others.
intro: At its core, Reiki operates on the principle that a universal life force energy flows through all living things, and disruptions in this energy can manifest as ailments or imbalances. The word “Reiki” itself is a combination of two Japanese words: “rei,” meaning universal, and “ki,” which refers to the life force energy. The process is remarkably gentle, with the recipient fully clothed and either lying down or seated comfortably. The practitioner’s hands may hover over specific areas of the body or lightly touch, guiding the flow of energy.

As individuals progress through the various levels of Reiki training – from Level 1 to Level 2 and finally attain the Master level – they undergo a process of self-discovery and energetic alignment. The journey involves not only learning the techniques of channeling healing energy but also delving into the spiritual principles that underpin Reiki.
Becoming a Reiki Master also opens the door to the possibility of teaching and attuning others to the practice of Reiki.

The curriculum of the Reiki Master level program at the Bali Yoga School combines traditional wisdom with contemporary understanding. Students are guided through the intricacies of Reiki symbols, attunements, and advanced techniques. The program also emphasizes practical application, allowing students to gain hands-on experience in providing Reiki sessions to others under the guidance of skilled instructors.

policies.title: Important Things to Know before Signing Up
items: Becoming a reiki healer completely depends on an individual’s austerity which can take years.
Reiki is not against medical science. It works together to bring a speedy recovery.
During the reiki practices, one should not indulge in sexual activities.
A true healer is never against medical science, but he/she always works together with it.

If any healer tries to make you believe that reiki healing is above medical science, do not believe the person because both practices work together just as your body needs both legs to make a balance.
Reiki and yoga work well together to achieve great health.
A true reiki healer’s energy speaks (honesty, compassion, respect, love).
Our course certificate confirms you have practiced the reiki under the supervision of an experienced teacher.

We suggest all the practitioners to pursue simple and nutritious diet / early sleep and early wake up / physical exercises / not to eat any kind of meat / take drugs or alcohol. Following the guidelines will help you to experience the depth of reiki practices.
